notes.title: Gunhead Update 1.44 - Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hey!

thanks!
- Lee

notes.title: GUNHEAD 1.4 - Repair Station, Ammo Refilling, French
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Update 1.4 is here with some large additions:
[list]
[*]'Mech Repair Station' now on player's ship. This will let you repair your mech during missions ($10k per repair, with a limit of 5 repairs per mission)
[*]Can now refill ammo at the License Station. Costs half of the license cost, multiplied by the ammo being refilled. Empty weapons/items no longer are removed from inventory.
[*]Added French language - thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UColXh0TCRpVPMzecBriXyOA]roman_tv20 [/url]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31219639/67e8f4687658ab561f4a3b7fbad8eb7124c346d8.gif[/img]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Added 'Crosshair Size' option
[*]Fixed issues with not being able to fit in space doors in some generated ships
[*]More fixes for Python fight - fixing invisibility issue and disappearing
[*]Fixed issue with Wreck music track not looping
[*]Fixed issue with language changing while playing
[*]Fixed a variety of terms that were not translating
[/list]

Thanks!
- Lee

notes.title: Gunhead 1.35 - Fixes
notes.content:
Hi again,
Fixes for 1.35:
- Fixed tractor beam when used on Sawblade
- Fixed issue if ingame menu was used after finishing level, and controls tried to rebind
- Fixed teleporting away Python issue
- Added 120 target FPS option

So some things we're considering for next update:
- A way to repair health while on the ship. Would be a station in the hanger to pay $ for health repair.
- A option to refill ammo of a weapon at license station. Would cost $, but not as much as buying weapon. Empty weapons would stay in inventory.

thanks,
- Lee

notes.title: GUNHEAD 1.3 - More fixes
notes.content:
Hey all,
Another day another update with fixes. We fixed all known bugs on our list - but definitely let us know of any issues in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/704000/discussions/]forums[/url]. We're also looking at feedback on our forums to decide on changes for the next content update.

1.3 fixes:
- Fixed rare generation issue with section with no doors to a section - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/704000/discussions/0/3958161899235023879/]forum post[/url]
- Fixed issue with the star map (ship selection) displaying wrong bonus reward amount
- Default FOV now 90. Can now set FOV in 5 increments.
- Updated Steam Cloud to not sync the settings, just profile/stats
- Fixed systems starting in the lava in Network - pipes section

thanks,
- Lee

notes.title: GUNHEAD 1.22- Fixes
notes.content:
Hi all,
We wanted to do a quick update to fix a few small things, and make a tweak to the in air movement.
We're going to do another update focused on fixes/bugs this weekend - then after that focus on the first content update.

Changes:
- Increased In Air move speed slightly
- Fixed issue with keys being in locked Core room in some generated Wreck levels ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/704000/discussions/0/3958161899237632424/]forum post[/url])
- Core room generation fixes
- Added 'In Space Blur' option to Game options
- Chinese language updates - should be a better translation

thanks!
- Lee

notes.title: Gunhead March dev log: PAX East, 'Factory' level style, new logo
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31219639/e7d3f1e6366d9d918111a8f471b092cc2b7eaf27.png[/img]

We will be at PAX East in the IndieMegabooth showing Gunhead! Along with our other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/729000/Wytchwood/]Wytchwood[/url]. All the development team will be there at booth 14071: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31219639/76076a107b2595e349e24be3d9e6daff0db2a36a.jpg[/img]

We are ALMOST at the point of having all the art complete in the game, and should be done with art production within the next 2 months. After that we still have a lot of work to do in terms of programming the bosses, and polishing existing systems (there are a lot of weapons/enemies...).
We won't be doing a early access release, but will be doing beta testing. Once we're ready to start letting players try it and give us feedback, we'll start a Discord and start handing out builds. Then release should be shortly after

The last 'ship style' added to the game was the 'Factory':

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31219639/46f3d5c6127b8f1663079d12e7bca4a89f39832d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31219639/177f571fa61b915fdefed9e92d42b18b0af71749.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31219639/1d590ae8f2ba0cd2d2f66a2a817bbb678352d5d4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31219639/f6f4366adc7fbaf95d2a6e042c1db6e3fca50f63.jpg[/img]

This is specifically on the more maze-like generated enemy ships - with a lot of moving platforms and parts. These ships are more likely to contain hazards, drone factories, jammer systems, and more complex enemies.

Along with that we've changed our logo (at top of this post) and updated all of our current Steam graphics. [url=https://imgur.com/a/2ojr9tX]Here is the old logo [/url]to compare. We felt the old logo focused too much on the bullet / military graphics, while the AI cyber brain is really the core of the game.

Let us know if your media / content creator, and want us to set a specific time to check out the game at PAX East by emailing contact (at) alientrap.com

Thanks for following these updates! 
- Lee

notes.title: Gunhead November Dev log! Loadouts and Research
notes.content:
It has been a while since our last dev log update! We've been working on some additional weapons and items (over 50 now), and putting together the full campaign and getting some of the unlockable systems in place.

Part of that is the Research and Loadout Screen:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HappyDemandingIlsamochadegu-size_restricted.gif[/img]

When you pickup a new weapon/item in the enemy ships it gets added to your 'Research Console'. You obtain research points from beating large bosses and accomplishing mission objectives, which can they be used to research weapons/items so they can be purchased with the Loadout Computer:

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/BareEminentChamois-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Unlike Cryptark when you find a weapon on a enemy ship it'll stay with you until you die - so the Loadout computer is to buy additional weapons or items between missions. Anything researched and unlocked will also stay between campaigns.

We've been experimenting with a LOT of weapon/item options. Some of which will be found on enemy ships (and then can be researched), while others will only be unlocked once enough other weapons are found/researched.

[b]Tractor Beam[/b] - A gravity-gun style weapon taken from Cryptark, grab your enemies from the air and fling them at each other:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S6UaZpm3luU

[b]Nail Shotgun[/b] - Painkiller inspired shotgun that nails enemies against the wall:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oqqfBWnwee0

[b]Repulser Shield[/b] - Push all enemy drones away with a air blast:
https://twitter.com/banjoduarte/status/1034796475866202121

[b]Vortex Grenade[/b] - A 'black hole' style grenade which pushes drones together, for easy destroying:
https://twitter.com/banjoduarte/status/1030838267896184837

[b]Drunk Rockets[/b] - Chaotic rockets that are good for clearing out large mobs of enemies:
https://twitter.com/banjoduarte/status/1027549501999833088

[b]Helix Gun[/b] - Descent inspired helix shotgun:
https://twitter.com/banjoduarte/status/1025103513301397504

[b]Snake Gun[/b] - Shoots in a wave snake pattern:
https://twitter.com/banjoduarte/status/1024293383404118017

A lot of the recent time has been finishing our final level styles - including 'Wrecked' ships which are basically Gunhead's Splelunky 'dark' levels:
https://twitter.com/banjoduarte/status/1037336096504463363
They will always have a 'radar jamming' system that is good to take out first, and feature more hazards and slow moving drones.

Hopefully we can post about a private beta soon! Thanks!
- Lee
